meta_description: Things to do around Casa Rossa: Brunello wineries, hill towns, thermal springs, walks and the Tuscan coast, with distances and a map.

hero.heading: The Area
hero.text: Brunello country, hill towns and the Tuscan coast, all within easy reach.

location.heading: In the heart of Brunello country
location.text: South of Siena in southern Tuscany, on the Castelgiocondo estate: 815 hectares of vineyards, forest and olive groves.
location.note: For restaurants, shops and everyday essentials, Montalcino is just fifteen minutes away and Buonconvento just twenty. Over the years we have got to know the best tables in town and across the Val d'Orcia, and we are always happy to book them for you, from a long lunch among the vines to a special dinner out.
